setting: deepest part of closed meromictic lake

identity_quality: Source interpretation and limitations as stated

thickness_quality: See source locator and measurement basis
caveats: Identified interval 282–345 cm = 63 cm. Overmann Fig.3 shows 260–330 cm, and text describes about 80 cm of ash accumulation within 70 years. principal_decision: The May 1985 core places the entire identified ash interval between 282 and 345 cm. Later input is documented. Under full primary capture, the 63 cm preserved total is a ceiling on its primary share.
principal_assumption: Assumes primary fallout was sufficiently retained in this interval at the deep meromictic basin and bulk compaction/loss is negligible. Prolonged enrichment and other descriptions of 70–80 cm make the conversion conditional. Compare weaker upper and omission.

caveats: About 50 cm for the recovered overlying ash deposit. Surface is described as a buried soil, unlike the active gravel fan at Sunrise.
